videos.title: The great sandwich disaster
videos.description: A sandwich, gravity and one wrong decision. Physical comedy, no words.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a cluttered kitchen counter with a tall absurd sandwich leaning like a tower, a pair of hands hovering nervously around it, playful light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The towering sandwich wobbles slowly and a slice slides off, the hands flutter anxiously, slight comedic camera push-in.

videos.title: A cat's opinion of Mondays
videos.description: The cat watches a laptop, then slowly pushes the mug off the desk.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a fluffy grey cat sitting on a desk next to a laptop and a mug, staring at the camera with a judgemental look, soft window light, no text
videos.motion: The cat slowly extends a paw towards the mug and nudges it, the mug slides to the edge, subtle camera push-in.

videos.title: Umbrella versus the wind
videos.description: An umbrella turns inside out at the worst possible time.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a windy rainy city street with a person seen from behind struggling with a bright umbrella being turned inside out, leaves flying, no face, no text
videos.motion: Wind whips the umbrella inside out, rain blows sideways, leaves swirl, handheld comedic camera shake.

videos.title: Rubber chicken audition
videos.description: A very serious casting call for a very unserious bird.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a rubber chicken sitting on a stool in front of a plain backdrop under a spotlight, a clapperboard blank beside it, playful tone, no people, no text
videos.motion: The spotlight flickers and a few feathers drift down, slow dramatic push-in on the chicken.
